*Sāsavaduka, Hetuduka* (Patthana 18.16) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final treatise of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka. The text belongs to the complex combinatorial matrix of the *Paṭṭhāna*, systematically cross-referencing dyads (*duka*)—here bringing together the *sāsava-duka* (the dyad regarding phenomena associated with or subject to mental effluents/taints) and the *hetu-duka* (the dyad concerning root conditions) to analyze the operation of conditional relations (*paccaya*).
